findings.text: VERIFIED ANSWER, and it is the check this node was dispatched for: a review JSON written by hand with json.dump (never through store_review) about a run whose base and head gate logs show added failures IS returned by reckon.crew.recovery.select_review_for_head carrying the added-failure count, the added ids and the capped total. Measured at a2c0a656 in a scratch tree extracted with git archive (module reckon.crew.review.__file__ = /tmp/a2c0a656-verify/tree/reckon/crew/review.py, cwd /tmp/a2c0a656-verify, RECKON_HOME=/tmp/a2c0a656-verify/home, base log FAILED {alpha,beta}, head log FAILED {beta,gamma,delta}, hand-written record total 19), command: RECKON_HOME=/tmp/a2c0a656-verify/home VERIFY_TREE=/tmp/a2c0a656-verify/tree PYTHONPATH=/tmp/a2c0a656-verify/tree /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/.venv/bin/python /tmp/a2c0a656-verify/verify_select.py; output line: [added-failures-unretired] select_review_for_head returned: {"added_failure_count": 2, "added_failure_ids": ["tests/test_gate.py::test_delta", "tests/test_gate.py::test_gamma"], "total": 5, "added_failures_note": "total capped at 5: the reviewed run added 2 failing test(s) not retired by name (tests/test_gate.py::test_delta, tests/test_gate.py::test_gamma)"} (review-select-verification.log:11); the ledger row a promotion would record carries that total (log:12), and the stored file's sha256[:16] is f9554f317c4fa5b1 before and after the read (log:10), so the annotation is a read-time view and the file is not rewritten. Retiring the two ids by name in the manifest prose returns the same count and ids with total 19, and a manifest naming no base log returns "added_failure_count": null with total 19 (log:17, log:23). Falsified by removing the annotation from annotate_review_of_run: the same selector then returns no count, no ids and total 19 (review-select-verification-mutation.log).

the after-cohort measurement is stated "against after f94c8b9b", but the receipt it cites names a different revision: review-cohort-after.log line 1 reads "revision 0684130beca0391ac3b3b3619b42d3a7f273a920 (after)" and its mtime 2026-09-26 21:28:10 precedes f94c8b9b's commit time (21:28:57), so it cannot be a run whose HEAD was f94c8b9b; the reviewed run's manifest repeats the claim in its own after_suite field (manifest.md:19, "revision": "f94c8b9b"), and the head commit exists so the measurement lines state the revision each log carries rather than a later head — for the after arm the stated revision is one the log does not carry, so the cohort's 0-added-failures result is not evidence about the landed read-path revision f94c8b9b, which rewrote reckon/crew/review.py after that log was written.

the cap note is written whenever the added ids are unretired, even when the record's own total is null, so the annotated record asserts a cap that was never applied: measured at a2c0a656, a hand-written record with "total": null and two added unretired ids comes back from select_review_for_head as "total": null with "added_failures_note": "total capped at 5: the reviewed run added 2 failing test(s) not retired by name (...)" (review-select-verification.log:29), and the same wording overstates when the stored total already sits at or below the cap and min() leaves it unchanged at reckon/crew/review.py:823-824; any returned record that is not parsed carries no total, so the misstatement does not require a defect in the reviewer's arithmetic.

item_verdicts.diff: read all seven commits against base 2184a9f1: bd575117 adds the derivation, the cap and the unmeasured rule, ab5e524b reformats, 9838365a conditions the annotation on a present manifest, e6340d81 and 0684130b write and correct the landing record, f94c8b9b moves the derivation from store_review to the read path and rewrites the tests to drive the production selector, a2c0a656 corrects the record text.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's cases are asserted against the production selector by tests/test_review_counts_added_failures.py (count by id with ids C and D and total at or below the cap at :136, retirement leaving the total alone at :155, no base log unmeasured and not zero at :173, the positive zero control at :187, no manifest leaving the record unchanged at :199); re-ran at a2c0a656: 5 passed, exit 0 (focused-gate-a2c0a656.log), equal to the run's own recorded 5 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that a review carries the added-failures-by-id count of the run it reviews, capped when unretired; at a2c0a656 every record read_review returns passes through annotate_review_of_run (reckon/crew/review.py:848, called at :982 and :985), which reads run_dir(run_id)/manifest.md and the two gate logs it names, and the measured hand-written case returns count 2, ids delta+gamma and total 5.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the focused gate at 5 passed exit 0 and the cohort at 1 failed / 76 passed either side, but its after_suite field states revision f94c8b9b while the log it names heads with 0684130b, and its negative control (2 failed / 3 passed) reproduces the declared direction.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_review_counts_added_failures.py and the two docs files; git diff --name-only 2184a9f1 a2c0a656 lists exactly those four paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the by-number negative control reddens tests/test_review_counts_added_failures.py (2 failed, 3 passed, exit 1) and removing the annotation leaves the returned record unannotated, so the assertions fail on the regressions they guard; :149 accepts any total at or below the cap, so a cap raised above the stored total would not redden it.
justifications.evidence: the focused gate is recorded and was reproduced (5 passed at a2c0a656, focused-gate-a2c0a656.log), but the manifest's after_suite revision (manifest.md:19) and docs/evidence/archive/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion-landed.html:1631 both state f94c8b9b while the cited receipt review-cohort-after.log:1 heads with 0684130b.
justifications.fit: the new helpers sit in the module's existing private-helper idiom with mechanism-stating docstrings (reckon/crew/review.py:502-639) and introduce no name the naming rules forbid, though the cap note at :825 is written even when the total is null.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:848 annotates every returned record from the reviewed run's own manifest, and the measured hand-written case returns count 2, ids delta+gamma and total 5.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 2184a9f1 a2c0a656 returns exactly the four declared paths, and reckon/crew/recovery.py is untouched.
